title: Rockstar says GTA has no generative AI or microtransactions.
summary: During a recent episode of the Kinda Funny Gamescast , Andy Cortez said he asked the studio point-blank about the topics and was told there would be no in-game monetization and that there was absolutely “no AI” used in the game.
